description:
Measure the 2023 Q3 market correction on an SPY daily chart. 

1. Open a Daily chart for SPY.
2. Locate the market peak (High) around July 27, 2023.
3. Locate the market bottom (Low) around October 27, 2023.
4. Use the Ruler drawing tool (F3) to measure from the exact High of the July peak to the exact Low of the October bottom.
5. Add a Text drawing tool near the measurement labeled "Summer Correction".
6. Save the workspace.
